name: com.tencent.qcloud.tuikit.tuicallkit.manager.feature.notification.NotificationRequestActivity
description: Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit opens this Activity when it needs permission to show call notifications. Android 13 and later request notification permission here; earlier versions show a prompt to open the app notification settings.
disableEffect: The kit cannot request notification permission through this screen, so incoming-call notifications remain unavailable until permission is enabled elsewhere.
